entry.title: Reshaping the future of next-gen applications and mobility in 5G

media:group.media:title: Reshaping the future of next-gen applications and mobility in 5G
media:group.media:description:
Nokia’s 5G mobility solutions are enhancing network coverage and reliability in sectors such as transportation, industry, public safety, and digital experiences. Our innovations minimize service interruptions and deliver high performance, ensuring seamless handovers for high-velocity transport and reliable links for connected vehicles across cell boundaries. Network reliability is increased meeting the stringent requirements of mission-critical and industrial applications. For urban IoT environments, advanced mobility management provides assured connectivity for vast numbers of low-energy devices, including sensors and wearables, supporting diverse use cases like health monitoring and environmental sensing.

entry.title: Vodafone Albania and Nokia showcase the future of intelligent 5G networks

media:group.media:title: Vodafone Albania and Nokia showcase the future of intelligent 5G networks
media:group.media:description:
Vodafone Albania and Nokia demonstrated one of the first AI-powered network slicing solutions within the Vodafone Group, combining a 5G Standalone (5G SA) network with advanced artificial intelligence to create a more intelligent, automated, and adaptive connectivity experience.
In this video, Balázs Révész, CEO of Vodafone Albania, explains how the demonstration showcases AI's ability to analyze both network conditions and real-world information in real time, enabling autonomous decisions that instantly optimize network performance. Instead of relying on predefined configurations, the network can dynamically allocate resources where they are needed most, helping deliver more efficient, resilient, and differentiated connectivity.
Watch how Vodafone Albania and Nokia are helping lay the foundations for the next generation of intelligent 5G networks.

media:group.media:description:
